title: Furniture
notes: Mattresses are a separate product group and not a category here — the working plan selects them separately from furniture. v1.3.0 (current) replaces the mandatory gtin with productIdentifier, a union of the EN 18219:2026 clause 5 ID schemes; a v1.2.0 record is read forward by a lens that wraps its gtin as scheme 1. v1.2.0 removes `mattress` from productType; v1.1.0 is kept for historical immutability and still accepts it.
